messages:
sara: Heads-up — customer hit /v1/rerank and got 500 + weird scores when their query contains emojis mixed with embedded NUL bytes. They said it worked before our deploy last week. Repro attached.

devon: Can you paste the raw request body and the service error?

sara: Here's the sanitized curl they ran (body has an embedded NUL and an emoji):
```
curl -s https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/rerank \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <redacted>\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  --data-binary '{"query":"find\\u0000 similar \\ud83d\\ude03","candidates":["item1","item2"]}'
```
Response: 500 and body: `{"error":"internal_server_error","message":"panic: invalid UTF-8 in scorer at offset 38"}`

marta: Do we know which client they used and any repro script?

sara: They sent a tiny Python repro (they run into this trying to pass binary-ish payloads):
```
# repro.py
import requests
# build bytes that include a NUL and a lone high-surrogate-ish byte sequence when coerced to str
b = b"find\\x00me" + bytes([0xED, 0xA0])  # not valid UTF-8 when interpreted as utf-8
payload = {"query": b.decode('latin1'), "candidates": ["a","b"]}
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/rerank', json=payload, headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer <redacted>'})
print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```
They said their code base calls `bytes.decode('latin1')` to coerce binary into a string and then uses requests' json= which UTF-8 encodes the string into the HTTP body — resulting in invalid sequences.

devon: Ok that matches my suspicion. Our gateway accepts the body and the reranker/native scorer expects valid UTF-8; passing these malformed sequences into native code causes the scorer to fail and produce -inf/panic. We should not allow this to reach the scorer.

ingrid: Proposed mitigation: validate body UTF-8 at the API gateway boundary and return 400/422 with a clear error code and safe hex snippet (no PII) when invalid. We should also log a short sample (first 64 bytes in hex) for debugging.

priya: Agreed. Short-term plan: add a UTF-8 validation middleware and a defensive guard in the scorer shim so invalid inputs return a structured 422 error instead of crashing. I'll add unit tests covering NULs, lone surrogates, overlong sequences across clients (py/node/go).

devon: On the worker side I'll update the scorer wrapper to run a UTF-8 validator before calling into the C++ scoring lib. Options: reject (422) or sanitize (replace invalid with U+FFFD). Prefer reject for now so clients fix their payloads; we can offer sanitize as a toggle.

marta: Can we provide guidance to customers? Short note: ensure you JSON-serialize only proper UTF-8 strings; in python avoid latin1 decode for binary, use base64 if you need to transmit binary. Example snippet for safe usage included in support reply.

ops-bot: Ticket SUP-8791 created: rerank-invalid-utf8 (owner=ingrid, sev=3)

sara: I updated the customer with SUP-8791 and suggested workarounds (use b.decode('utf-8') or base64-encode binary segments; in Node avoid Buffer.toString('binary')). They replied with the request id 9c4f and said 422 is fine as long as we document the fix.

priya: I'll open a PR with two commits: (1) gateway utf-8 validation middleware + tests, (2) worker guard to return structured 422 and log safe hex digest. Adding regression that fuzzes control-chars + emoji combos. Will mark for review.

devon: After PR lands I'll add a regression eval that submits randomized control chars + emoji mixtures and asserts scorer does not panic and that scores are finite.

ingrid: Action items:
- [ ] Deploy UTF-8 validation middleware to canary (ingrid)
- [ ] Worker scorer guard + 422 error (devon/priya)
- [ ] Support doc blurb + client guidance (sara)
- [ ] Regression fuzz tests across py/node/go (priya)

marta: Plan to ship middleware to canary tonight, observe for 2 hours, then promote if green.

sara: Thanks — I'll keep the customer updated and link SUP-8791.
